title: SQLFlow pipeline
description: A SQLFlow data pipeline: read a source, evolve the target schema, and load it.

name.description: Unique pipeline name. Also the stable flow identity (a deterministic GUID is derived from it).

flowType.description: Document-kind discriminator. Omit for a file flow (source/target/schema/load, as in this schema). Each value parses as a different document shape not covered by this schema file: ing a table-to-table ingestion, exp a file export, sp a stored procedure, inv an ADF/Automation trigger, hc an ML health check, scm a database source-control snapshot, batch an ordered multi-flow batch, api a generic acquisition (HTTP/SFTP/Azure Table), cpy a file copy, sftp an SFTP transfer, cal a generated calendar dimension, trl a JSON translation (query result to template-shaped documents, saved to a destination and optionally delivered to an API). Matched case-insensitively; an unrecognized value fails to load.

batch.description: Optional grouping label (source system) this flow reports under in the catalog and run history. Reporting only; never an execution input for a file flow. Blank/whitespace normalizes to unset.

mode.description: Execution mode. auto (default): runs on schedule fires and in batch/node group runs. manual: reserved for direct triggers. disabled: deactivated (a retired source or run-once replay); excluded from automatic execution and from descendant selection unless the run opts into find-all, still runnable directly.

schedule.description: When the catalog scheduler should run this flow. Mirrored into the catalog on sync; the engine itself never schedules anything. A block with neither cron nor intervalSeconds is treated as absent.

cron.description: Cron expression (5-field standard, or 6+ fields with a leading seconds field), evaluated in timezone via the Cronos library. Mutually exclusive with intervalSeconds.

intervalSeconds.description: Fixed interval in seconds between runs, as an alternative to cron. Must be positive. Mutually exclusive with cron.

enabled.description: Whether the schedule is active. Default true. A disabled schedule still syncs to the catalog but never fires.

timezone.description: IANA time zone identifier the cron expression evaluates in, for example Europe/Oslo. Default UTC. Not consulted for intervalSeconds schedules.

source.description: Where the data is read from.

type.description: Source kind. Selects the reader: csv, xls/xlsx, json/jsonl/ndjson, xml, parquet/prq (native readers), or duckdb/delta (DuckDB-backed scan over parquet, CSV, JSON, or a Delta table; delta always resolves to the Delta format regardless of the format option).

location.description: Path, folder, or URI to read. For CSV/JSON: a file or a folder (with options.srcFile).

options.description: Reader-specific options. The CSV, XLS, JSON, XML, and Parquet keys are listed below; values are strings. Parquet is columnar and self-describing, so it uses only the shared file-selection, provenance, key, and schema options (plus partitionList/expectedColumnCount).

sheetName.description: XLS: worksheet to read. Empty = first sheet; with useSheetIndex it is a 0-based index.

sheetRange.description: XLS: cell range to read, e.g. A1:D100. Empty = whole used sheet.

useSheetIndex.description: XLS: treat sheetName as a 0-based sheet index instead of a name.

rootPath.description: JSON: JSONPath the records live under, e.g. $.data.records. $ = document root. An array there fans out to one record per element.

includePaths.description: JSON: comma-separated whitelist of paths to flatten. Empty = flatten everything.

excludePaths.description: JSON: comma-separated paths whose subtree is dropped (no column).

jsonPaths.description: JSON: comma-separated paths kept verbatim as a single JSON-string column instead of being flattened.

explodePaths.description: JSON: comma-separated array paths to explode - each element becomes its own output row. Several exploded arrays cross-product.

pathAliases.description: JSON schema-evolution aliases: map version-specific paths to one column, e.g. person_name=$.user.name|$.user.firstName; id=$.id|$.userId. A missing source path is filled by another (never nulled).

separator.description: JSON: separator joining nested keys into a column name (default _), e.g. address_city.

maxDepth.description: JSON: maximum nesting depth flattened into columns; deeper values become JSON strings. Default 10.

arrayHandling.description: JSON: how an unconfigured array becomes a column. to_json (default) keeps it as a JSON string; explode makes every array emit one row per element.

joinSeparator.description: JSON/XML: separator used when array/repeat handling is join (default comma).

rowXPath.description: XML: XPath selecting the row (record) elements (carries the original hierarchyIdentifier). Empty = each direct child of the root; . = the root element itself.

xmlPaths.description: XML: comma-separated paths kept verbatim as a single XML-fragment column (the XML analog of jsonPaths). Paths use / syntax, e.g. /meta, /vendor.

repeatHandling.description: XML: how repeating sibling elements become a column. to_xml (default) keeps them as one XML fragment; explode makes each element its own row.

includeAttributes.description: XML: whether attributes become columns (default true). An attribute is addressed as /@name.

attributePrefix.description: XML: prefix applied to an attribute's column name (default @). Set e.g. attr_ to keep an attribute distinct from a same-named element.

stripNamespacePrefixes.description: XML: strip namespace prefixes from element/attribute names so paths and columns use local names (default true).

hierarchyIdentifier.description: XML: legacy alias for rowXPath (the original PreIngestionXML column name).

partitionList.description: Parquet: partition column list carried for metadata fidelity (Hive-style datasets). Recorded, not used to drive reads.

srcPathMask.description: Regex over the full path (name and/or folder) to further filter files.

searchSubDirectories.description: Recurse into sub-folders of the location.

delimiter.description: Column delimiter. Use \t for tab. Default comma.

qualifier.description: Text qualifier that lets a field contain the delimiter or a newline. Default double quote.

escapeCharacter.description: Escapes a qualifier inside a quoted field.

commentCharacter.description: Lines beginning with this character are skipped.

columnWidths.description: Comma-separated fixed column widths for fixed-width files (no delimiter).

header.description: First row holds column names. Default true. False generates Column1..N.

firstRowSetsExpectedColumnCount.description: Use the first row's column count as the expected count.

expectedColumnCount.description: Expected number of columns; rows that differ raise an error. 0 disables.

srcEncoding.description: Source encoding: UTF8 (default), Unicode (UTF-16), UTF32, ASCII.

skipStartingDataRows.description: Number of leading data rows to drop (a preamble).

skipEndingDataRows.description: Number of trailing data rows to drop (a footer).

trim.description: Trim surrounding whitespace from every value (true/false).

stripControlChars.description: Remove non-printable control characters from values.

maxRows.description: Cap how many rows are loaded; 0 = all.

readAhead.description: How many source files to keep open at once (1 to 32). Files are still read one at a time in file order; a higher value only opens and downloads the next ones ahead of their turn, which pays off for many small remote files. Defaults to 4 for the streaming formats (csv, json) and 1 for formats that hold a whole file in memory (xls, xml, parquet), where each extra open file multiplies the peak.

maxBufferSize.description: Parser read buffer size in bytes.

showPathWithFileName.description: Store the full path (not just the name) in FileName_DW.

includeFileName.description: Inject the FileName_DW provenance column (default true).

includeFileDate.description: Inject the FileDate_DW provenance column (default true).

includeFileRowDate.description: Inject the FileRowDate_DW provenance column (default true).

includeFileSize.description: Inject the FileSize_DW provenance column (default true).

includeDataSet.description: Inject the DataSet_DW provenance column (default true).

includeRowNumber.description: Inject the RowNumber_DW provenance column (default true).

includeHashKey.description: Inject HashKey_DW: a per-row hash (varbinary) for dedup when there is no business key.

hashKeyColumns.description: Comma-separated columns to hash. Empty = all source columns (system columns excluded).

hashKeyType.description: Hash algorithm: SHA2_512 (default), SHA2_256, SHA1, MD5.

includeConcatKey.description: Inject ConcatKey_DW: a readable composite key built from the chosen columns.

concatKeyColumns.description: Comma-separated columns to concatenate. Empty = all source columns.

initFromFileDate.description: Earliest file date to include (inclusive). Read from the file's modified time by default, or from the path/name when fileDate.from is set. yyyy-MM-dd or a timestamp.

initToFileDate.description: Latest file date to include (inclusive). Read from the same source as initFromFileDate.

fileDate.from.description: Where the date window reads each file's business date: modified (file timestamp, the default), path (Hive partitions or a pattern in the folder path), or name (a pattern in the file name). A path date lets discovery prune whole out-of-window partition folders.

fileDate.hive.description: With fileDate.from: path, read the date from Hive key=value partition tokens (year=2025/month=03/day=05). Mutually exclusive with fileDate.pattern.

fileDate.pattern.description: Regex yielding the date, for fileDate.from path or name. Named groups year/month/day/hour, or unnamed groups in that order. Missing finer parts widen the window (a year-only match spans the whole year). Mutually exclusive with fileDate.hive.

fileDate.partitions.description: For a duckdb source with a Hive fileDate: the ordered partition columns to push the window down onto (default year,month,day). Only year, month, and day are recognized.

copyToPath.description: After a successful load, copy each ingested file here.

zipToPath.description: After a successful load, compress each ingested file to here.

srcDeleteIngested.description: Delete each file after it is ingested.

srcDeleteAtPath.description: Delete the file at the source path after ingestion.

defaultColDataType.description: SQL type for raw columns when creating the target (overrides the global default).

columnDelimiter.description: CSV: alias for delimiter (legacy column name). Consulted only when delimiter is absent or blank.

textQualifier.description: CSV: alias for qualifier (legacy column name). Only the first character is used. delimiter/qualifier take precedence when both are set.

firstRowHasHeader.description: CSV/XLS: alias for header (legacy column name). Consulted only when header is absent or unparseable.

trimResults.description: CSV: alias for trim (legacy column name). trim takes precedence when both are set.

encoding.description: CSV: source text encoding, matched case-insensitively; unrecognized or absent falls back to UTF-8. Takes precedence over the srcEncoding alias.

srcPath.description: Fallback file-search root used only when source.location is absent (location wins when both are set).

format.description: DuckDB: explicit scan format selecting read_parquet / read_csv_auto / read_json_auto / delta_scan over the location. Default is inferred from the location's extension. Ignored when source.type is delta, which always resolves to delta.

query.description: DuckDB: verbatim SQL wrapped as the FROM relation '(<query>) AS _src'; when set it takes precedence over the location scan. The flow author is the trust boundary, like any other authored SQL in this file.

filter.description: DuckDB: verbatim WHERE expression pushed into the query for predicate pushdown; AND-combined with any fileDate partition predicate and the injected incremental watermark predicate.

columns.description: DuckDB: comma-separated projection of column names to select from the relation, in the given order; matching is case-insensitive. Default is every column.

hivePartitioning.description: DuckDB (parquet/prq format only; a delta-typed source never reaches this branch): adds hive_partitioning to the scan so Hive key=value path partitions surface as columns. Auto-enabled when fileDate.from is path with fileDate.hive true.

unionByName.description: DuckDB (parquet/prq format only; a delta-typed source never reaches this branch): reconciles files whose columns differ in order or presence (schema drift across parts) by name instead of position.

deltaVersion.description: DuckDB Delta time travel: pins delta_scan to this snapshot version instead of the latest. Takes precedence over deltaTimestamp when both are set.

deltaTimestamp.description: DuckDB Delta time travel: an ISO timestamp pinning delta_scan to the snapshot current at that time. Consulted only when deltaVersion is absent.

extensions.description: DuckDB: comma-separated extensions to INSTALL/LOAD before the scan, on top of the auto-implied ones (delta for a Delta table; azure for abfss/abfs/az/azure locations; httpfs for s3/gs/gcs/r2/http(s)).

cloudAuth.description: DuckDB: opt-out switch for the auto-generated Azure CREATE SECRET. off/false/none/no/0 (case-insensitive) disables auto-generation, leaving auth to init. Any other value or absence keeps the default auto-detection.

init.description: DuckDB: semicolon-separated verbatim setup statements (SET / CREATE SECRET and similar) run on the connection before the query. A CREATE SECRET here suppresses the auto-generated Azure secret.

flowId.description: Reserved, engine-injected: overwritten after parsing with the flow's deterministic GUID. An authored value never survives; do not set this.

incrementalAfterDate.description: Reserved, engine-injected: the file-date incremental watermark's exclusive lower bound, written by the engine before file listing. Do not author this directly.

incrementalColumn.description: Reserved, engine-injected: the row-level watermark column name for incremental.watermarkColumn mode, written by the engine. Do not author this directly.

incrementalValue.description: Reserved, engine-injected: the canonical serialized row-level watermark bound compared with strict greater-than. Do not author this directly.

incrementalKind.description: Reserved, engine-injected: the watermark value kind governing how incrementalValue is parsed and compared. Do not author this directly.

fullLoad.description: CSV only. Legacy field carried over from the old per-format metadata table for compatibility; bound into the flow's metadata record but not consumed by any V3 file-pipeline code path. Setting it has no effect on the load. Use the flow's incremental.fullLoad instead.

deactivateFromBatch.description: Legacy field carried over from the old per-format metadata table for compatibility; bound into the flow's metadata record but not consumed by any V3 file-pipeline code path. Setting it has no effect on the load.

enableEventExecution.description: Legacy field carried over from the old per-format metadata table for compatibility; bound into the flow's metadata record but not consumed by any V3 file-pipeline code path. Setting it has no effect on the load.

fetchDataTypes.description: Legacy field carried over from the old per-format metadata table for compatibility; bound into the flow's metadata record but not consumed by any V3 file-pipeline code path. Setting it has no effect on the load. V3 type inference is driven by transform.inferTypes.

syncSchema.description: Legacy field carried over from the old per-format metadata table for compatibility; bound into the flow's metadata record but not consumed by any V3 file-pipeline code path. Setting it has no effect on the load. V3 schema evolution is governed by schema.evolve.

noOfThreads.description: Legacy field carried over from the old per-format metadata table for compatibility; bound into the flow's metadata record but not consumed by any V3 file-pipeline code path. Setting it has no effect on the load. V3 file readers stream sequentially.

onErrorResume.description: Legacy field carried over from the old per-format metadata table for compatibility; bound into the flow's metadata record but not consumed by any V3 file-pipeline code path. Setting it has no effect on the load. Batch-level error policy lives in the batch document instead.

preFilter.description: Legacy field carried over from the old per-format metadata table for compatibility; bound into the flow's metadata record but not consumed by any V3 file-pipeline code path. Setting it has no effect on the load.

preProcessOnTrg.description: Legacy field carried over from the old per-format metadata table for compatibility; bound into the flow's metadata record but not consumed by any V3 file-pipeline code path. Setting it has no effect on the load. Use the flow's top-level preProcess list instead.

postProcessOnTrg.description: Legacy field carried over from the old per-format metadata table for compatibility; bound into the flow's metadata record but not consumed by any V3 file-pipeline code path. Setting it has no effect on the load. Use the flow's top-level postProcess list instead.

preInvokeAlias.description: Legacy field carried over from the old per-format metadata table for compatibility; bound into the flow's metadata record but not consumed by any V3 file-pipeline code path. Setting it has no effect on the load.

servicePrincipalAlias.description: Legacy field carried over from the old per-format metadata table for compatibility; bound into the flow's metadata record but not consumed by any V3 file-pipeline code path. Setting it has no effect on the load. Cloud auth flows through the file stores / SQLFLOW_AZURE_AUTH instead.

trgServer.description: Legacy field carried over from the old per-format metadata table for compatibility; bound into the flow's metadata record but not consumed by any V3 file-pipeline code path. Setting it has no effect on the load. The real target comes from the flow's target section.

trgDBSchTbl.description: Legacy field carried over from the old per-format metadata table for compatibility; bound into the flow's metadata record but not consumed by any V3 file-pipeline code path. Setting it has no effect on the load. The real target comes from the flow's target section.

trgDesiredIndex.description: Legacy field carried over from the old per-format metadata table for compatibility; bound into the flow's metadata record but not consumed by any V3 file-pipeline code path. Setting it has no effect on the load. Use the flow's top-level desiredIndexes key instead.

target.description: The SQL Server table to load into.

connection.description: Connection string, or a reference like ${env:SQLFLOW_DW}. Never a raw secret committed to the file.

schema.description: Schema evolution policy and column typing.

evolve.description: create: create if missing, never alter. widen: add new source columns. strict: fail if the source has columns the target lacks.

defaultColumnType.description: SQL type for raw (untyped) columns when creating the table. Default varchar(255).

overrides.description: Per-column type/nullability overrides keyed by column name.

type.description: Explicit SQL type for this column.

load.description: How rows are written to the target.

mode.description: append: add rows. truncate-load: empty the target first (full refresh).

tableLock.description: Take a table lock during the bulk load. Default true.

manageIndexes.description: On an existing table, disable non-clustered indexes before the load and rebuild them after.

resetWhenConsolidated.description: Reset (truncate) a chained landing target at the start of the next run once every flow that directly reads its typed view has completed a successful run after this flow's last successful load, so the staging table stops growing without bound. Default true; applies only to an append-mode flow that generates the typed view and only to control-plane runs (the node proves delivery from lineage and the run ledger; a direct CLI run never resets). A backfill bounded to a window or filter never resets (the whole staged dataset must reach the downstream merge); a plain forced full load keeps the gate and becomes a clean staging rebuild. Set false to keep the landing rows across runs.

incremental.description: Incremental load: probe the target for a watermark and read only newer files. The target table is the state; no control database is needed.

table.description: Fully qualified table to probe for the watermark. Defaults to this flow's target.

dateColumn.description: Date/datetime column whose MAX is the watermark. Default FileDate_DW.

overlapDays.description: Days subtracted from the watermark to re-read a safety window. Default 0.

fullLoad.description: Ignore the watermark and reload everything.

watermarkColumn.description: Row-level watermark mode (alternative to the file-date mode above): column whose MAX the engine probes on the target; only rows past it (minus watermarkOverlap) are read, filtered identically across every source kind.

watermarkOverlap.description: Amount subtracted from the probed watermarkColumn bound to re-read a safety window, in the column's own unit (days for a date, seconds for a datetime, or a plain numeric step). Default 0.

transform.description: Pre-ingestion transform: type inference and authored per-column transforms over the raw landing table, projected into a typed view the target is loaded through.

inferTypes.description: Infer optimal SQL types for the raw string columns.

onConvertError.description: When a value cannot convert: produce NULL, or fail loudly.

threshold.description: Fraction of values that must convert for a type to be chosen (0..1).

sample.description: Rows to sample for inference; 0 = all.

preserveLeadingZeros.description: Keep values with leading zeros as strings rather than numbers.

generateView.description: Generate the typed transformation view [schema].[v<Table>] over the flow's loaded table as a post-process (default true); downstream flows read the view for correct types. Set false to skip it.

columns.description: Authored per-column transforms (the source of truth), one entry per column that is cast, renamed, computed, or dropped. An authored transform overrides inference for that column; inference fills the rest.

name.description: The raw source column the transform applies to (for a virtual column, the name of the computed column).

expr.description: SQL expression producing the value; @ColName is substituted with the quoted source column. Required for a virtual column.

as.description: Output column name (alias) in the view. Default: name.

type.description: Declared target SQL type, e.g. varchar(50). With no expr, the transform is CAST(@ColName AS type).

order.description: Column position in the view. Lower first; unset columns keep natural order.

virtual.description: A computed column with no raw source counterpart. Requires expr; @ColName is not valid here.

excludeFromView.description: Compute nothing into the view's final projection; drop this column from the view output.

desiredIndexes.description: One or more CREATE INDEX statements. Built when the table is created; an existing table's indexes are disabled/rebuilt around the load instead.

preProcess.description: SQL run on the target before the load (statements or EXEC a procedure).

postProcess.description: SQL run on the target after the load.
